task: Implement the esl-verbs MVP exactly as specified in SPEC.md: a static, no-build, 4-mode English verb quiz (typed Japanese answers for modes 1-2, tap-to-talk English speech recognition with interim-result matching for modes 3-4, mic-free 4-choice fallback, TTS prompts, 10-question rounds, end screen with practice-mistakes). One shared config-driven engine, not four implementations.
requirements: Read SPEC.md fully first; it is the frozen design. src/vocab.js is the vocabulary source and must not be modified.
Create src/normalize.js, src/engine.js, src/speech.js, src/tts.js, src/app.js, index.html, styles.css per the SPEC Architecture section.
Speech matching checks every alternative of every result on each onresult event and accepts immediately without waiting for isFinal; a session ending with no match is 'Try again', never wrong.
Permission denied, unsupported SpeechRecognition, or 3 consecutive recognition errors switch on mic-free (マイクなし) automatically with the Japanese message from SPEC; the player can never get stuck.
Audio-only modes (2,4) never reveal the prompt when TTS fails; they show an error + Replay, while answering/Show answer still work.

Add focused node:test tests in test/ (no new dependencies, no jsdom): mode view-model for all 4 modes (prompt visible/hidden, input type, speak lang/text) including micFree switching modes 3/4 to choices; Japanese checking (primary, kanji alternate, katakana/hiragana equivalence, romaji e.g. 'noboru' for climb, wrong answer fails, 'のぼる ' with spaces passes); English normalization (capitalization, punctuation, leading 'to ') ; findMatch with a mocked results list where {transcript:'Climb.', isFinal:false} matches; TapToTalk with an injected fake SpeechRecognition class: an interim result triggers onCorrect and stop() immediately, not-allowed error triggers the unavailable callback; scoring (correct increments, wrong does not subtract, streak increments/resets, bestStreak preserved); createRound gives 10 unique items; practice round contains only missed ids; makeChoices returns 4 distinct choices with exactly one correct.
Every vocab `ja` is unique and every jaAccepted entry normalizes to a non-empty string — add a data-integrity test for this.

Record any meaningful design decision you make that SPEC.md does not already cover in DESIGN_DECISIONS.md (date 2026-09-24, what, why, rejected alternative). Update CURRENT_STATE.md with what exists, how to run it, and what still needs a real Chromebook/microphone test.
constraints: No frameworks, no bundler, no npm dependencies. Plain ES modules loaded by index.html via <script type=module>.
Do not add anything SPEC.md lists under 'No:'.
Keep it small: this is an MVP; no speculative abstractions.
Edit files with structured file tools, not shell heredocs/sed, for anything with regexes or Japanese text.
Do not modify src/vocab.js or SPEC.md.
startingPoints: ../esl-time/src/speech.js (read-only reference for recognition error handling; do not import or modify)

behavioralAcceptance.description: Controller will serve the page and drive all 4 modes start-to-result in a real browser with mocked speech APIs.
